items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: There was Manny Klein, Hal Kemp, Skinny Ennis, some others. Maybe you weren't on the date.

ctx.x: You did. You made a record. The Dorsey Brothers Concert Orchestra recorded for Okeh records, July 16, 1928. Well maybe you didn't play with him. There was Manny Klein, Hal Kemp, Skinny Ennis, some others. Maybe you weren't on the date.
